design.purpose: A small desk tray for one person to hold rings, earrings or a USB stick between two raised end towers.

steps.c: Place the brown 2×8 plate flat on the table.
Press the dark red brick onto the left end.
Press the green brick onto the right end.
Stack the red brick fully on the dark red brick.
Stack the orange brick fully on the green brick.
